This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Veamon]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Jedi" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin, solid blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and textured chins.<ref name="Jedi" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Veamon]],<ref name="Jedi" /> worked as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5]]<ref name="5-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> and [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="10-Date">The opening crawl of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' states that the game's events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' as taking place during the year [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Using simple addition, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' can be determined to take place during the year [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared<ref name="Jedi" /> in the [[1997]]<ref name="MC">{{WebCite|url=https://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/star-wars-jedi-knight-dark-forces-ii|text=Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II for PC Reviews|archivedate=20200409213403}}</ref><ref name="GR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamerankings.com/pc/24354-star-wars-jedi-knight-dark-forces-ii/index.html|text=Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II for PC|archivedate=20191209015004}}</ref> video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''.<ref name="Jedi" />
